shortDescription: Add or remove host to stacki front-end

options.name: appliance
options.description: Appliance to be used in host creation. Required if O(state=present) and host does not yet exist.

options.name: force_install
options.description: Set value to V(true) to force node into install state if it already exists in stacki.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the host to be added to Stacki.

options.name: network
options.description: Network to be configured in the host. Currently not used by the module.

options.name: prim_intf
options.description: Name of the primary network interface. Currently not used by the module.

options.name: prim_intf_ip
options.description: IP Address for the primary network interface. Currently not used by the module.

options.name: prim_intf_mac
options.description: MAC Address for the primary PXE boot network interface. Currently not used by the module.

options.name: rack
options.description: Rack to be used in host creation. Required if O(state=present) and host does not yet exist.

options.name: rank
options.description: Rank to be used in host creation. In Stacki terminology, the rank is the position of the machine in a rack. Required if O(state=present) and host does not yet exist.

options.name: stacki_endpoint
options.description: URL for the Stacki API Endpoint.

options.name: stacki_password
options.description: Password for authenticating with Stacki API, but if not specified, the environment variable E(stacki_password) is used instead.

options.name: stacki_user
options.description: Username for authenticating with Stacki API, but if not specified, the environment variable E(stacki_user) is used instead.

options.name: state
options.description: Set value to the desired state for the specified host.
